parts: I'm planning a trip to Japan with my family. My daughter Avni would love the cherry blossoms.
Japan is wonderful for families! Cherry blossom season runs from late March to early April.
We visited in 2019 and loved it. Want to explore Kyoto's tea culture this time — I'm really into tea.
Kyoto's Uji district is famous for matcha. You could visit traditional tea houses and attend a tea ceremony.
